notes.title: System issue notice
notes.content:
Hello fellow comrads!

If you are experiencing crashing or start up issues with the latest version, please refer to the following to check your software settings and take action.

[h3]If you cannot proceed to the title when the application starts.[/h3]
[list]
[*]If you are a beta tester, please delete the following folder or all data in it.
%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\PreappPartners\Shachibato
You can open the folder directly by typing the above path in the Windows key + R.
If the AppData is not displayed, please change the setting to display the hidden file.

[*]Please check the settings of your security software.
If you are using a virtual container such as Comodo, you may not be able to launch the game due to virus scanning software.
Please refer to your product manual for instructions.
[/list]

[h3]When a crash occurs when running the application.[/h3]
[list]
[*]Please make sure that the OS and specifications of your PC meet the requirements.
[*]Please update your Windows version and graphics drivers.
[*]Please update your Windows version and graphics drivers to the latest version to ensure stable operation.
[/list]
